task1.title: Men and women with driving licences in a European country
task1.prompt: The charts give information about the percentage of men and women who had driving licenses in one European country in various years.

chartDesc.title: Percentage of men and women with driving license in total / Percentage of young drivers between 17–20 years old
chartDesc.overview: Overall, the proportion of adults holding a driving license increased overall for both men and women from 1976 to 2006, with men consistently remaining higher than women. Conversely, for young drivers aged 17–20, the percentages for both genders fell between 1996 and 2006.
keyFeatures: Total women driving license holders doubled from 30% in 1976 to 60% in 2006.
Total men license holders grew steadily from 70% in 1976 to a peak of 80% in 2006.
Among 17–20 year olds, male license holders fell from 50% in 1996 to 44% in 2006.
Among 17–20 year olds, female license holders declined from 28% in 1996 to 19% in 2006.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
task1.sampleBand8:
The two bar charts show what percentage of men and women held a driving licence in one European country between 1976 and 2006, and how many young people aged 17–20 held one in 1996 and 2006.

Overall, licence ownership among the population as a whole rose steadily for both sexes, with the gap between men and women narrowing considerably. Among young drivers, however, the trend was the reverse, as the figures for both young men and young women fell over the decade shown.

In 1976, 70% of men had a driving licence, more than double the figure for women, at just 30%. Male ownership then edged up gradually, reaching 78% in 1996 and 80% in 2006, despite a slight dip to 77% in 2001. The proportion of women with a licence grew far more quickly, climbing steadily at each five-year interval to reach 60% by 2006 — double its starting level, although still twenty percentage points below the male figure.

The picture for 17–20-year-olds was quite different. In 1996, half of young men and 28% of young women held a licence, but by 2006 these figures had declined to 44% and 19% respectively, meaning young women were the least likely of all the groups shown to drive.
task1.uzSampleBand8:
Ikkita ustunli diagramma bir Yevropa mamlakatida 1976–2006-yillarda erkak va ayollarning necha foizi haydovchilik guvohnomasiga ega bo'lganini hamda 1996 va 2006-yillarda 17–20 yoshli yoshlarning qanchasi unga ega bo'lganini ko'rsatadi.

Umuman olganda, butun aholi orasida guvohnoma egaligi har ikkala jins uchun barqaror o'sib bordi va erkaklar bilan ayollar o'rtasidagi farq sezilarli darajada qisqardi. Biroq yosh haydovchilar orasida tendensiya teskari bo'ldi: ko'rsatilgan o'n yillikda yosh yigitlar ham, yosh qizlar ham bo'yicha ko'rsatkichlar pasaydi.

1976-yilda erkaklarning 70 foizi haydovchilik guvohnomasiga ega edi — bu ayollar ko'rsatkichidan (atigi 30%) ikki baravardan ko'proq. Keyin erkaklar orasidagi egalik asta-sekin ko'tarilib, 1996-yilda 78 foizga, 2006-yilda esa 2001-yildagi 77 foizlik yengil pasayishga qaramay 80 foizga yetdi. Guvohnomali ayollar ulushi ancha tezroq o'sdi: har besh yillik oraliqda izchil ko'tarilib, 2006-yilga kelib 60 foizga yetdi — bu boshlang'ich darajasining ikki baravari, garchi hali ham erkaklar ko'rsatkichidan yigirma foiz band past bo'lsa-da.

17–20 yoshlilar manzarasi butunlay boshqacha edi. 1996-yilda yosh yigitlarning yarmi va yosh qizlarning 28 foizi guvohnomaga ega bo'lgan, biroq 2006-yilga kelib bu ko'rsatkichlar mos ravishda 44 va 19 foizga tushib qoldi — demak, ko'rsatilgan guruhlar ichida yosh qizlar mashina haydash ehtimoli eng past guruh bo'lgan.

task2.title: Increasing household waste: reasons and solutions
task2.prompt: In many countries, household waste (e.g., food packaging) is increasing day by day. What are the reasons for this? How can this problem be solved?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
task2.sampleBand8:
The volume of rubbish produced by ordinary households, from food packaging to disposable products, is growing rapidly in many countries. This essay will outline the main causes of the problem and suggest some practical remedies.

Several factors explain the increase. The most important is the rise of consumerism: people simply buy more than previous generations did, and almost everything they buy comes wrapped in plastic, cardboard or foil. Modern lifestyles make this worse, as busy families rely on ready-made meals and takeaway food, which are sold in single-use containers. In addition, many goods are now deliberately designed with short lifespans — a policy known as planned obsolescence — so appliances and gadgets are thrown away and replaced rather than repaired. Finally, in places where rubbish collection is cheap and convenient, householders face little incentive to cut down on what they discard.

Fortunately, effective solutions exist at several levels. Governments can tax excessive packaging, ban certain single-use plastics and introduce deposit-return schemes for bottles and cans, all of which push both manufacturers and shoppers towards reusable alternatives. Producers, for their part, should be required to design packaging that is recyclable or biodegradable. At the individual level, householders can shop with their own bags, choose products with minimal wrapping, compost food scraps and sort their waste for recycling — habits that schools and media campaigns can help to instil from an early age.

In conclusion, growing household waste is driven mainly by consumer culture, convenience packaging and throwaway product design. Since the causes lie with governments, producers and consumers alike, the solution must involve all three, combining regulation with genuine changes in daily habits.
task2.uzSampleBand8:
Oddiy xonadonlar ishlab chiqaradigan chiqindilar hajmi — oziq-ovqat qadoqlaridan tortib bir martalik mahsulotlargacha — ko'plab mamlakatlarda tez o'sib bormoqda. Ushbu insho muammoning asosiy sabablarini bayon qilib, bir qancha amaliy yechimlarni taklif etadi.

Bu o'sishni bir nechta omil izohlaydi. Eng muhimi — iste'molchilik madaniyatining kuchayishi: odamlar avvalgi avlodlarga qaraganda shunchaki ko'proq xarid qiladi va sotib olgan deyarli har bir narsasi plastik, karton yoki folga o'ramda keladi. Zamonaviy turmush tarzi buni yanada og'irlashtiradi: band oilalar tayyor taomlar va olib ketiladigan ovqatlarga tayanadi, bular esa bir martalik idishlarda sotiladi. Bundan tashqari, ko'plab mahsulotlar endi ataylab qisqa umr ko'rishga mo'ljallab ishlab chiqariladi — bu rejali eskirish deb ataladi — natijada maishiy texnika va gadjetlar ta'mirlanish o'rniga tashlab yuborilib, yangisiga almashtiriladi. Nihoyat, chiqindi olib ketish arzon va qulay bo'lgan joylarda xonadon egalarida tashlaydigan narsalarini kamaytirishga deyarli rag'bat bo'lmaydi.

Baxtga qarshi emas, samarali yechimlar bir necha darajada mavjud. Hukumatlar ortiqcha qadoqlashga soliq solishi, ayrim bir martalik plastik turlarini taqiqlashi va shisha-bankalar uchun garov-qaytarish tizimlarini joriy etishi mumkin — bularning barchasi ishlab chiqaruvchilarni ham, xaridorlarni ham qayta foydalaniladigan muqobillarga undaydi. Ishlab chiqaruvchilardan esa qayta ishlanadigan yoki biologik parchalanadigan qadoq yaratish talab qilinishi kerak. Shaxsiy darajada xonadon egalari o'z xaltalari bilan xarid qilishi, kam o'ramli mahsulotlarni tanlashi, oziq-ovqat qoldiqlarini kompost qilishi va chiqindilarini saralashi mumkin — bu odatlarni maktablar va media kampaniyalari erta yoshdan singdirishga yordam beradi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, maishiy chiqindilarning o'sishi asosan iste'mol madaniyati, qulaylik uchun qadoqlash va "ishlatib tashla" tamoyilidagi mahsulot dizaynidan kelib chiqadi. Sabablar hukumatlar, ishlab chiqaruvchilar va iste'molchilarning barchasiga tegishli ekan, yechim ham tartibga solishni kundalik odatlardagi chinakam o'zgarishlar bilan uyg'unlashtirib, uchchalasini qamrab olishi lozim.
